essence: The ritual action should be completed up to and including the dismissal after incense and related offerings.
The materials named are āragvadha and śoṇālu.
The mantra is regarded as a five-syllabled formula characterized as vasuvarṇa.
The practitioner should perform the ṛṣyādi placement and the hand and limb placements.
The deity is visualized with palms at the breast tips and hands holding the Veda, a chisel, and the desired item.
